name: Hippocampus
subjectPrompt: A single graceful mythological sea horse with the unmistakable horse-like head, short equine muzzle, proud arched neck, large sea-green eyes, slim muscular equine chest, and two front legs ending in tapered hooves. Below the forequarters it becomes one muscular tapering scaled fish tail emerging continuously from the body, curving around and terminating in one broad translucent pale pink-blue tail fin. No hind legs or extra tails. Saturated teal, jade, and muted pearl on its front body, pale ivory underbelly, crest of narrow pink fin rays. Clear near side silhouette, positioned diagonally, head raised at upper left and curled tail at lower right. Use the turquoise Kobold Press creature as the main visual reference.

name: Orca
subjectPrompt: A full-bodied adult orca described as one realistic killer whale with dramatic black upper skin, crisp white eye patches and underside, subtle silver saddle, tall single dorsal fin, two visible rounded pectoral fins, and one continuous strong tapering tailstock ending in two sideways-spreading horizontal flukes of one tail. Distinct marks anatomically arranged, one dark eye on the near side under and just forward of the white patch. Broad nose and smooth skin, closed mouth. Gliding toward the lower left, slightly angled at the viewer, with its entire left flank, dorsal fin and tail at right clearly visible. Avoid exaggerated cartoon expressions, no water or splashes.

name: Weasel, Giant

Full-body alert, low prowl on all four short paws with its long tapered furry tail bent outward, facing right in a three-quarter view. Fine whiskers, tiny rounded paws, and the proportions and curious expression of a real long-tailed weasel. No harness, spear, or other equipment.

name: Wolf, Dire
subjectPrompt: One imposing thickly built dark-furred dire wolf. Heavy broad skull, russet amber eyes, huge shoulder ruff, subtly grizzled gray cheeks, and powerful canine paws. Long black charcoal and mottled smoke-gray fur, small upright ears, continuous naturally lowered bushy tail. Entire animal in a three-quarter view with head at the left and front of the composition, taking a deliberate stalking step. Nostrils and teeth visible in a restrained natural snarl, no blood. Coat and gait inspired by the subject references. Four legs only with distinct paws and unobstructed natural silhouette.
